핵심이슈.summary:
## 오늘의 한국 경제 흐름 요약

글로벌 인플레이션 압력이 다시 고개를 들고 있다. 미국의 4월 PPI가 유가 급등의 영향으로 전월 대비 1.4% 상승하며 4년 만에 최고치를 기록했고, ECB 정책위원도 유가 충격으로 인한 스태그플레이션적 징후를 경고하면서 주요국 중앙은행의 고민이 깊어지고 있다. 이런 가운데 미국 채권시장에서는 수익률 곡선이 가팔라지는 스티프닝 현상이 나타나 경기 낙관론과 인플레이션 우려가 혼재된 신호를 보내고 있으며, 한국 채권시장 역시 우호적이지 않은 환경에 놓여 있다는 분석이 제기되었다. 한편 연준은 RRP(역레포) 규모를 매달 100억 달러씩 추가 축소하며 시중 유동성 조절에 나서고 있다. 국내에서는 이러한 불확실한 거시 환경 속에서도 서울 아파트 증여가 작년 대비 3배 급증하며 강남3구로의 자산 쏠림이 두드러져, 자산가들이 세금 부담을 감수하면서도 핵심 부동산 자산을 선제적으로 이전하려는 움직임이 가속화되고 있다.

key_headlines.title: KOSPI Approaches 8,000 Mark Amid Strong US Tech Rally and Retail Investor Support
key_headlines.summary: The Korean stock market's KOSPI index is pushing toward the 8,000 level, driven by strong semiconductor stocks and sustained retail investor buying interest despite foreign investor selling.

key_headlines.title: Government Lowers EV Subsidy Eligibility Standards, Foreign Manufacturers Like Tesla Likely to Benefit
key_headlines.summary: The government has substantially loosened evaluation criteria for EV manufacturer subsidy eligibility, with standards shifted away from domestic industry contribution requirements.

sections.Hot Economy News: The Korean economy is experiencing mixed signals as government officials express serious concerns about potential Samsung Electronics strikes affecting growth, exports, and financial markets. Seoul apartment prices are surging across all districts with gift transfers tripling year-over-year, while the real estate market shows signs of recovery driven by reconstruction expectations and interest rate cut prospects. The government has taken steps to alleviate housing market pressure by allowing mortgage-secured property sales regardless of ownership limits, resulting in a significant increase in Seoul listings. The economic outlook has improved notably, with Korea Development Institute raising growth forecasts from 1.9% to 2.5%, though employment growth slowed to its lowest level in 17 months in April.
sections.Macro & Fiscal Policy: The Bank of Korea and the Ministry of Strategy and Finance held their first joint meeting, agreeing to harmoniously coordinate fiscal and monetary policies to strengthen growth potential and crisis response capacity. Government and central bank officials collectively warned that a Samsung Electronics strike would pose substantial risks to economic growth, exports, and financial markets, emphasizing the need for dialogue-based resolution. Treasury bond yields have risen recently, reflecting global inflation concerns and changing monetary policy expectations from major countries, though strong fiscal soundness provides a foundation for attracting foreign investment through WGBI inclusion. The Korea Development Institute assessed that fiscal policy stimulus is not critically necessary given the economy's expanding phase, with semiconductor boom offsetting Middle East conflict impacts.
sections.Financial Markets: The KOSPI index is hovering around 7,900-7,920 levels, approaching the psychological 8,000 milestone, driven primarily by individual investor buying while foreign investors and institutions maintain selling positions. Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix have attracted unprecedented international investor interest, with US institutional and retail investors actively investing in Korean equities at levels exceeding Bitcoin ETF interest. However, despite annual gains of 300% for the KOSPI, semiconductor stocks maintain attractive valuations with PER ratios around 6x compared to competitors like Micron at 9x. Bond markets have experienced volatility with US Treasury yields and Korean 30-year government bond yields surpassing 4%, reflecting inflation concerns and diminished interest rate cut expectations.
sections.Industry & Technology: Polaris AI is accelerating the domestic AI semiconductor ecosystem by expanding applications of Korean-made AI processors to on-device AI and robotics sectors. Paratech, a listed safety equipment manufacturer, is showcasing specialized fire safety systems targeting high-tech industries including data centers, semiconductor facilities, and electric vehicle-related infrastructure. Concerns mount regarding potential Samsung Electronics strikes, with labor unions arguing against government arguments to restrict workers' right to collective action based on economic importance. The government has significantly relaxed eligibility standards for electric vehicle subsidies, lowering the threshold and potentially allowing foreign manufacturers including Tesla to qualify for Korean EV incentives.
sections.Real Estate: Seoul apartment prices have surged across all districts with the strongest gains in 10 years, breaking the trend of recent slowdown despite government efforts to stabilize the market through stricter household loan management and capital gains tax increases on multi-property owners. Following government measures enabling the sale of mortgage-secured properties regardless of ownership limits, Seoul property listings increased by approximately 400 units within a day, signaling market momentum shift. The rental market faces prolonged tightness, with deposit requirements surging significantly as new lease transactions show record highs in a decade, forcing many renters to strategize regarding contract renewal rights and new city development opportunities. Gangnam districts have reversed their downtrend, with reconstruction expectations and interest rate cut anticipation driving renewed investment interest.
sections.International Economy: The Federal Reserve appointed Kevin Wash as the new chairman, who will preside over the June 16-17 FOMC meeting amid substantial pressure from the Trump administration to lower interest rates despite persistent inflation. US inflation remains elevated with both consumer and producer prices surging significantly, complicating the Fed's policy decisions and raising questions about inflation durability. The ECB faces stagflationary pressures with oil price shocks creating concerning signs despite broader economic considerations. Markets are closely monitoring Wash's first FOMC decision as it will signal the Fed's independence stance and set the trajectory for US monetary policy amid competing domestic and international economic pressures.
sections.AI & Economy: The government is developing differentiated innovation growth strategies for different industries in the AI transformation era, adopting a 'Fast Follower' strategy in foundation models dominated by global big tech companies while pursuing a leading position in biotech. MegaZone Cloud is positioning itself as an 'orchestrator' for multiple AI agents, emphasizing the critical need for governance systems to prevent chaos in multi-agent AI environments. Korea-Vietnam economic cooperation is expanding toward future industries with bilateral agreements on AI, telecommunications, and cybersecurity, targeting 150 billion dollars in bilateral trade by 2030. Companies across manufacturing sectors including Sampoong Group are strengthening executive leadership development focused on AI-driven innovation and manufacturing paradigm shifts.
sections.Others: DSM announced its vision transformation to become a 'Physical AI Company' following its corporate merger and name change, unveiling comprehensive mid-to-long-term roadmaps for stakeholders. Y2Solutions recorded over 2x growth with first quarter revenues of 86.7 billion won and operating profit of 1 billion won, driven by business stabilization and rapid bioenergy sector expansion in European markets. Cisco Systems is reducing its workforce by up to 4,000 employees to redirect resources toward artificial intelligence business expansion despite recording strong quarterly earnings. Xi Jinping warned that mishandling the Taiwan issue could trigger US-China confrontation, while the Trump administration discussed Taiwan arms sales plans, creating tension regarding Taiwan's negotiation position.
